column1: In a small bowl, mix the maple syrup, soy sauce, garlic, garlic salt and pepper.
Cut the salmon into 4 even fillets and arrange in a shallow glass baking dish.
Pour the maple mixture over the fish, cover and refrigerate 30 minutes, flipping once halfway.
Bake uncovered for 15–20 minutes, until the salmon flakes easily with a fork and reaches 145°F (63°C) in the thickest part.
